coverage: Read all eight domain briefs, EAL source route/target/answer structures, graph predicates and 24 state records. Derived route statuses per state, then checked authored labels. Ran offline preflight: 800 assigned cases, 24/24 EAL/equal graph parity, 120/120 paired acquisition tamper rejections, zero model calls.
genealogy: The eight briefs are domain parameterisations of one generated two-positive-route, primary-targeted-alert, separate-resolution skeleton from one author. The four adverse supported states exercise qualifying alternatives; the other four exercise contested primary routes. This is selected developmental coverage, not eight independent graph mechanisms.
limitations: Authored labels were visible; this is an unmasked AI review and not human adjudication.
Independence, findings, quantitative observations and acquisition are assertions in synthetic records; different named tools do not prove independent physical measurement.
Source EAL and generic graph share a fixture generator even though the checker is independent code.
The finite statuses do not establish current physical system behaviour.
